usedFor: Kanban Zone holds cards, and Google Drive copies a file for each one through “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Card Created” in Kanban Zone, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Every new card gets its own copy of a brief or checklist saved in a chosen folder.

watchOut: “Card Is Moved” fires on each move, so “Copy a File” can make several copies for one card.
